description.fallback: Jean Pierre Polnareff confronts Joseph Joestar about his hand, asking him if his left hand is actually a right hand. Confused by the unusual question, Joseph reveals it is a prosthetic hand, as he lost his real one in a battle a long time ago. Polnareff explains his question by telling the group how his sister was raped and killed by a man with two right hands.

outro.fallback: Jotaro grabs the kid and tries to drag him to shore, but accidentally touches his chest and discovers "he" is actually a girl, who calls him a pervert for grabbing her chest.
Meanwhile, the shark is cut in two by a mysterious aquatic creature.
